title: Agricultural Shipping Container Sensor Event
description: Streaming IoT event schema for refrigerated agricultural shipping containers. Each event represents a single sensor reading emitted at a fixed interval (typically 30–60 seconds) during cold-chain transport.

container_id.description: Unique identifier for the shipping container (ISO 6346-style).

shipment_id.description: Identifier linking the container to a specific shipment manifest.

commodity_id.description: Unique identifier for the agricultural commodity in the master dataset.

timestamp.description: UTC timestamp when the sensor reading was captured (ISO 8601).

latitude.description: GPS latitude of the container at reading time (decimal degrees).

longitude.description: GPS longitude of the container at reading time (decimal degrees).

temperature.description: Internal container temperature in degrees Celsius. Cold-chain produce typically ranges 0–8 °C.

humidity.description: Relative humidity inside the container (percent). Produce cold-chain target is 85–95%.

vibration.description: Vibration intensity in g (gravitational acceleration). Normal transit is 0–0.5 g; impacts may exceed 2 g.

battery_level.description: Remaining battery charge of the IoT sensor unit (percent).

transport_status.description: Current phase of the container in the logistics lifecycle.

anomaly_type.description: Active sensor anomaly classification for the current reading.

health_score.description: Composite container health score (0–100) derived from temperature, humidity, vibration, and battery readings against commodity-specific ideal conditions.

spoilage_percentage.description: Estimated cumulative spoilage (0–100%) based on commodity shelf life, environmental stress, and container health.

remaining_shelf_life_days.description: Estimated remaining shelf life in days, derived from cumulative spoilage and the commodity's configured shelf life.

spoilage_risk_level.description: Discrete spoilage risk classification derived from spoilage percentage.
